caseNameFull: John Barton Payne, Agent, etc. v. Industrial Board of Illinois
attorneys: Mr. George B. Gillespie, Mr. H. N. Quigley, Mr. Leonard J. Hackney and Mr. James Vause, Jr., for plaintiffs in error, submitted. Mr. Michael M. Doyle, with whom Mr. Bryan H. Tivnen and Mr. Thomas R. Figenbaum were on the brief, for defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Act of February 8, 1899, c. 121, 30 Stat. 822; LeCrone v. McAdoo, 253 U. S. 217, 219.
